meta.title: DeepSeek Chat
meta.description: Adds a native DeepSeek Chat mode beside Agent mode, with a shared Chat | Agent switch. It supports deep thinking with Off/Low/High/Max effort, web search with citations, URL reading, file and image upload, model selection, persistent history, folders, pin/archive, history search, message editing, answer versions, and Chat to Agent handoff. New long-term memory: opt-in cross-session memory and automatic extraction, a settings page to view/edit/delete memories, a generated memory summary, natural-language Ask or Update, and import of existing memory from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other assistants. Chat uses the signed-in DeepSeek account or a DeepSeek API key stored in the DSH credential store; the key never reaches the browser. Web search, document parsing and automatic memory processing use DeepSeek services and may incur usage charges. Agent mode and existing DSH capabilities are unchanged.
